description: State Representative Kelly Keisling (R-Byrdstown) has received the endorsement of the Tennessee Professional Fire Fighters Association for his reelection campaign to the Tennessee House of Representatives.The TPFFA represents 35 affiliates and approximately 7,100 active and retired firefighters, fire prevention professionals, fire instructors, EMS personnel, and emergency services workers across the state of Tennessee. The organization has served Tennessee's fire service community since 1960."I
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kelly Keisling for State Representative, John Keisling, Treasurer
title: State Rep. Kelly Keisling Receives Endorsement from Tennessee Professional Fire Fighters Association
